infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GuideAI uses the camera to describe surroundings and interpret supported signs. Camera frames are not stored by default.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GuideAI listens so another person's speech can be captioned and translated into sign language.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GuideAI uses your location and heading to guide you along pavements, crossings and traffic.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: GuideAI uses motion sensors to know which way you are facing while navigating.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: GuideAI transcribes speech so it can be shown as captions and signed back to you.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: GuideAI uses the local network to create a private nearby conversation with another GuideAI device.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow GuideAI to use the camera for surroundings and supported signs.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow GuideAI to turn speech into captions.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow GuideAI to provide walking directions while the app is open.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Allow GuideAI to use motion to improve heading while navigating.
